invariants.rationale: A non-null cacheKey may be required for meaningful behavior in a typical cache API.
If ids is to be used as a varargs array, it should not be null.
The length of any array is always non-negative.
If ids is non-empty, the first element is a valid int. This is always true but not a tautology; it helps clarify typing concerns.
The first element of the ids array must not exceed the max int value, clarifying value range.
